info.title: pj-Flim API
info.description: Public catalog, accounts, playback, personal library and reports; admin API with MFA/RBAC, audit and publication checks; RabbitMQ HLS/backup worker and signed webhook. Development Swagger UI and JSON are public. Use Authorize with an access JWT for protected API requests. Local signed CDN delivery URLs do not expire with API playback sessions.

bearer.description: Access JWT after password and MFA when required. Local AUTH_MFA_REQUIRED=false allows password-only API login. Use Authorize to supply this JWT; Swagger never grants API permissions.

mfa-context.description: Limited challengeToken returned by login or step-up. Cannot call admin endpoints.

playback-management.name: X-Playback-Management
playback-management.description: Guest-only management token; cannot be replaced by telemetry token.

playback-telemetry.name: X-Playback-Telemetry
playback-telemetry.description: Session-scoped event ingestion token; cannot manage playback.

enabled.description: Explicit consent. False ignores watchlist/progress and clears feedback and feeds.

hideCompleted.description: Hide titles whose currently playable episodes are all completed; applied only when enabled.

errorCode.description: Stable error code, never URL or exception text.

intervalStartSeconds.description: Start of continuous interval actually watched; omit on seek.

encodingPreset.description: Immutable H.264/AAC ABR preset; source dimensions cap the actual outputs.

expectedBytes.description: Exact original file size in bytes; verified against Cloudinary.

sourceFormat.description: Original container, for example mp4. No filename or provider URL is accepted.

episodeId.description: Must equal the episode bound to this upload intent.

reason.description: Reason for retrying a failed processing attempt.

code.description: Six digit TOTP, or one unused recovery code.

managementToken.description: Returned only for guests. Send via X-Playback-Management; never via query string.

expiresAt.description: Always null for current static signed delivery. API session expiry does not expire the CDN URL.

retryable.description: Retry only safe operations or the same idempotent intent.
